content: MCP in-process client testing: from mcp import Client; async with Client(mcp) as client: result = await client.call_tool('name', params); result.structured_content gives the result. No subprocess, no network — direct in-memory transport. Tests use async context managers and pytest-asyncio or asyncio.run(). strip_server_info() is an SDK test helper but not needed in user tests. Each test creates its own Client instance for isolation.
